title: Ancient terrestrial civilization with near-luminal travel

plain: An advanced civilization may have lived on Earth many hundreds of millions of years ago, perhaps one able to travel close to the speed of light, and its traces may have been wiped out by "the relentless reshaping of the surface of the planet". Eric Haseltine, a former senior NSA official, tells Michels this is one of the ideas explored in the book The New Science of UFOs, and he cites a man named Chris Gilbert. He offers it as a possibility, not a finding, and does not point to any evidence. If true, some of what gets called alien could have started here on Earth.
